scope: WPF selected card conversion target mode and Recast presentation; no rule/schema/content-version changes in this batch.

problems.case: Real standard:wusheng uses a physical red Iron Chain as Slash
problems.before: Target mode inspected every action for the physical entity without matching the explicitly selected conversion source. All four portraits, including actor, stayed legal; Recast remained visible.
problems.baselineObservation: multi=True, recast=True, UI legal=0,1,2,3, native legal=1,3
problems.after: Source-specific single-target mode; only currently published Slash targets highlighted, Recast hidden.

problems.case: Real classic:guhuo declares physical Barbarian Assault as Barbarian Assault
problems.before: Same entity also had declared Iron Chain actions, so UI stayed in chain mode and suppressed its published complete three-target AOE choices.
problems.baselineObservation: multi=True, combos=0, native targets=1,2,3; declared chain Recast=True although no native Recast action
problems.after: Declared AOE mode shows the one complete current-source target combination. Native printed AOE retains its targetless ordinary confirmation. Declared Iron Chain offers no Recast control or hint.

changes: Match exact selected primary ConversionSource when deriving Iron Chain mode and portrait target candidates.
Filter published whole-target combinations by selected primary source using existing parameter parser; retain and revalidate AdditionalConversionSources.
Show Recast only when the current source has a published Recast action; retain empty-target and tutorial restrictions.
Make empty selection hint and context guide follow actual Recast availability and explicit source selection.
Extend existing conversion-provenance and Iron Chain target-count registrations with focused native WPF regressions; preserve original checks and runner/scopes.

fixtures.preparation: Native StartGame, actual SelectGeneral, at most 40 bounded AdvanceOneStep commands to actual PlayCard prompt; native checkpoint loaded through real manual save command.
fixtures.registry: Standard content, actual active/rescue/classic packages and small fixture owner/deck; fixture owner registers actual standard:wusheng or classic:guhuo without reimplementing their rules.
fixtures.wusheng: Heart Iron Chain, actual red-as-slash source, button and Enter routes from separate manual reloads; native Slash target set=1,3.
fixtures.guhuo: Native printed Barbarian Assault has empty targets; actual declare-barbarianAssault source targets=1,2,3. Actual declare-IronChain source retains native target draft but no published Recast.
assertions: Before-submit all four CreateSnapshot(viewerSeat) safe views, revision, commands, events and movements remain unchanged.
Reject stale, withdrawn and equal copied source/combination objects without toggling source, paying or clearing current draft.
Accepted current controls issue one exact PlayCard command/source/targets/revision/prompt and one physical Hand-to-Processing payment.
Compare accepted command JSON, physical movements and all four safe views with independent native checkpoint execution.
Cold serialize/deserialize checkpoint restoration retains exact commands, movements and four safe views.
Retained native Iron Chain target-count, explicit conversion, stale prompt/Borrowed Sword, geometry, tier and polarity coverage.
